title: Bram and the Room
author: Noor Winterbourne
blurb: Sable Amberdale, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
